summary: Bug: Workorder -> Parts tab is not showing the data in the relevant columns
reported_issue: On a Work Order's Parts tab, the part-request data was not appearing under the correct headers/columns (misalignment).
expected_after_fix: Each part-request value is displayed under its correct column header on the WO Parts tab.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened work order S9-24011 which has many requested parts.
Clicked the WO Parts sub-tab (link_part_requests_tab), landing on /workorders/<id>/part-requests.
Read the table header row and the first data rows cell-by-cell to check header/value alignment.
actual_now: The Parts tab renders 13 headers: Description, Part Number, Quantity, Cost, Core, Sell Price, Margin, Category, Vendor, Requested At, Status, Actions (plus expand). The part-request row values map correctly to their headers: Description='Engine Oil Filter', Category='Uncategorized', Requested At='Jun 25, 2026', Status='Requested', with Cost/Core/Sell Price/Margin inputs under their respective columns. Data appears under the correct columns.
notes: Column-to-value alignment is correct on current staging; the misalignment described in the ticket does not reproduce.
